description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a dashboard screen in a meal planner and calorie tracker app. It displays user info, weekly summaries, and tips, and manages data refresh via providers.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the main dashboard screen of the app.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class for DashboardScreen, managing loading state and data refresh.

classes.name: _WeeklyBarChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget for visualizing weekly data as a bar chart.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers data refresh when widget is inserted into the tree.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes user meal data for the day and week.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard, including user info, weekly summary, and tips.

methods.name: _WeeklyBarChart.build
methods.description: Builds the weekly bar chart visualization.
